description: Variation of Conditions 2 (approved drawings) and 3 (materials) of the planning permission reference: 2025/00430/FUL dated 14th May 2025 for the "Erection of a rear extension at second floor level, over part of the existing back addition; erection of a single storey rear extension, to the side of existing back addition; repositioning of an existing dormer window, to the rear elevation of existing rear mansard roof; alterations to existing external steps." To allow a minor amendment to the approved scheme, by a reduction in the overall roof height from 2580mm to 2505mm; minor adjustments to the gutter detailing; relocation of the gutter outlet; change to design and materials used for the door to the rear of the extension.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of the original decision dated 14th May 2025 (Ref: 2025/00430/FUL). 

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004). 
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the approved plans and drawings listed in this decision notice, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission.

- 200 REV D;
- 004 Rev A;
- 300 Rev A;
- 005 Rev A rec 13.05.2025;
- Flood Risk Assessment dated Feb 2025. 

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Walls: London stock brick to match the existing building in terms of brick and mortar colour and bond pattern.  

- Roof extension: Natural or artificial slates/tiles which shall match the colour, shape and size of the existing roof.

- Roof of single storey extension: Aluminium

- Windows: Timber frames/, colour  to match the existing/original windows of the property.

- Doors: White uPVC and Black Metal

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - The roof of the extensions and the remainder of the roof of the existing back addition shall not be converted into or used as a terrace or other open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roof/remainder of the roof of the back addition or the extension hereby approved. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected around the roofs and no alterations shall be carried out to the property, including the extension hereby approved, to form an access onto the roofs. 

Such a use would be detrimental to the amenities of neighbouring properties by reason of overlooking and loss of privacy and potential noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies CC11 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 5 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the details contained within the approved Flood Risk Assessment [dated Feb 2025]. No part of the development shall be used or occupied until all flood prevention and mitigation measures have been installed in accordance with the submitted details and the development shall be permanently retained in this form and maintained as necessary thereafter.

To limit the impact on flood risk and mitigate the susceptibility of the development to flooding in accordance with Policies CC2, CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
